figures.finding: A salary is taxed by the gross monthly amount at 0% to €700, 9% from €700.01 to €1,000 and 15% above; entrepreneurial income at 0% to €8,400 a year, 9% to €12,000 and 15% above; other income at 15%. A municipal surtax of 13% of the tax (15% in Podgorica and Cetinje) is added.
figures.applies: 2026; poreskauprava/gov.me not read in this pass, so PwC is quoted.

sources.said: Salaries up to 700 euros (EUR) (gross) are subject to 0% tax. Salaries between EUR 700.01 and EUR 1,000 (gross) are subject to 9% tax. Salaries exceeding EUR 1,000 (gross) are subject to 15% tax.
Earnings up to EUR 8,400 are subject to 0% tax. Earnings from EUR 8,400.01 to EUR 12,000 are taxed at 9%. Earnings exceeding EUR 12,000 are taxed at 15%.
A surtax rate of 13% applies in all municipalities, except Podgorica and Cetinje, where the rate is 15%. The surtax base is calculated based on the amount of PIT assessed.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the annual return is due by the end of April; entrepreneurs pay in 12 monthly instalments.

sources.said: A tax year in Montenegro is the calendar year. Tax returns Generally, taxpayers are obligated to submit an annual tax return by the end of April for income generated in the previous calendar year.

figures.finding: The payer withholds tax at source from employment income and royalties, among others; other income is paid with the return.

sources.said: certain types of income (employment income, income from capital, property-related income, royalties, etc.) are subject to withholding at the source by the payer.

figures.finding: A non-resident performing entertainment, cultural-artistic or similar programmes in Montenegro has 15% withheld by the payer; royalties to non-residents also bear 15%; treaties may reduce it.

sources.said: Legal entities are obliged to calculate and pay 15% WHT at the moment of payment of income on the following income categories:
Income earned by non-residents on the basis of performing entertainment, cultural artistic, sports, or similar programmes in Montenegro.

figures.finding: The employee bears the whole 10% pension and disability contribution (capped at €75,453 a year for 2025) and 0.5% unemployment insurance; the employer pays 0.5% unemployment insurance.

sources.said: For 2025, pension and disability insurance contributions are capped at EUR 75,453 annually. The entire pension and disability insurance, set at a rate of 10%, is borne by the employee. Costs of unemployment insurance are borne by both the employee at a rate of 0.5% and by the employer at a rate of 0.5%.

figures.finding: VAT is 21%; registration is mandatory above €30,000 turnover in the last 12 months.

sources.said: VAT registration is mandatory for entities whose turnover exceeds the EUR 30,000 threshold within the last 12-month period.
